skill.summary: Provides general guidance on fueling, hydration, and nutrient timing tailored to your sport, training load, dietary preferences, and performance goals.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Sports Nutrition Basics skill.
- Provides general macronutrient frameworks tailored to sport/activity type, training load, and dietary preferences.
- Offers practical pre-, during-, and post-activity meal and hydration suggestions.
- Addresses hydration guidelines, electrolyte needs, and signs of dehydration.
- Educates on supplement use with a food-first, neutral, and conservative approach.
- Includes clear safety and boundary guidance emphasizing educational intent, not individualized medical or meal plans.
